choices.text: Tell me about the flying companion...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Right. Going back to the story about Kuntur, his companion, Iktomisaurus, was a Saurian with great powers of flight.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: You could even say that without Iktomisaurus's help, Kuntur would've found his success much harder to win.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: A flying companion's pretty convenient... and come to think of it, yours flies, too. So, she have any special skills?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: She can make terrifying amounts of food disappear nigh-instantaneously.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Amazing! Any chef worth their salt would be overjoyed to hear of such a skill.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Let me cook for her next time, alright? My friends from Natlan all told me that I should stay and cook for the Saurians — said I'd be a smash hit.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: So yeah, I'm sure your companion would enjoy my food too!

choices.text: Tell me about the hot springs...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Ah, I've seen a few in Fontaine, hot enough to scald you! I hear that wherever the Emperor of Fire and Iron dwells, the waters there are exceptionally hot...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: But Natlan's hot springs are different. Now, how should I put it... they can heal wounds of body and spirit both.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: That's what makes them so addictive, in fact...

choices.text: I've got other things to handle. See you around.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: No worries. I'll wait for you here.
